subject: Error in if (condition) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.author: 9da3c71a89709b4f
messages.subject: Error in if (condition) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Dear community,

as I am relatively new to simsem and R in general, I don't know what to do to avoid this error message...
Does anybody of you have an idea what to do?

Here's my syntax:

loadingValues <- matrix (0, 20, 2)
a1 <- 0.26
.... (continue like this with a2, a3, ...)
....
a10 <- 0.29
b1 <- 0.46
...(continue like this with b2, b3, ...)
...
b10 <- 0.49
loadingValues[1:10, 1] <- c("a1", "a2", "a3", "a4", "a5", "a6", "a7", "a8", "a9", "a10")
loadingValues[11:20, 2] <- c("b1", "b2", "b3", "b4", "b5", "b6", "b7", "b8", "b9", "b10")
LY <- bind(loadingValues)
error.cor <- matrix(0, 20, 20)
diag(error.cor) <- 1
RTE <- binds(diag(20))
latent.cor <- matrix(0.3, 2, 2)
diag(latent.cor) <- 1
RPS <- binds(latent.cor, 0.3)
VY <- bind(rep(NA,20),2)
CFA.Model <- model(LY=LY, RPS=RPS, RTE=RTE, modelType="CFA")
dat <- generate(CFA.Model, 100, maxDraw=100,  misFitType="all", misfitBounds=NULL, averageNumMisspec="FALSE", optMisfit=NULL, createOrder=c(1,2,3), sequential=TRUE, facDist=NULL, errorDist=NULL, saveLatentVar=TRUE,indLab=NULL, modelBoot=NULL, realData=NULL, covData=NULL, params=TRUE, group=NULL, empirical=TRUE )   

Error in if (condition) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Thx a lot!

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: Error in if (condition) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
The averageNumMisspec argument in generate reuqires either  TRUE or FALSE as input, not "TRUE"


Another note (to make coding easier): There's no need to include all arguments for a function in the function call (if you're okay with the default, you can leave it out). So your call to generate could be:

dat <- generate(CFA.Model, 100, maxDraw=100,  misFitType="all",averageNumMisspec=FALSE, createOrder=c(1,2,3), sequential=TRUE, saveLatentVar=TRUE,params=TRUE, empirical=TRUE )

Alex
